# slackapp_installation_inventory (Data Source)

Experimental read-only installation observations for supplied app IDs in one workspace, using the Slack CLI's apps.status API. Include known owned or third-party IDs from a reviewed catalog; visibility depends on the service token and remains unverified for third-party apps. An omitted ID or flag is unknown, never uninstalled. This does not discover IDs or attest a complete workspace inventory or granted token permissions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_ids` (Set of String)
- `workspace_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `all_requested_apps_observed` (Boolean) Whether Slack supplied an explicit status for every requested ID. This does not establish full workspace coverage.
- `observed_at` (String) UTC timestamp when this response was observed.
- `statuses` (Map of String) Every requested app ID mapped to installed, uninstalled, or unknown.
